1669-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1669-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2074-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-2074-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1414-2866-3899-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

5932-8094.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
5932-8094.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Homer triggers, causing you and any number of opponents to each mill a number of cards.
If you milled a land this way, Hedge Shredder triggers, putting the land(s) onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land(s) enter, Homer triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Homer trigger, causing you and any number of opponents to each mill a number of cards.
Repeat from step 3.
5932-8094.notes: Controlling more Crabs, Lobsters, Nautiluses, Starfish, and/or Trilobites will increase the chance of success for this combo. With excess Homer triggers, you can choose to not mill yourself.

5078-6089-6595.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

855-2021-2060-2313.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3258-7334-7417.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
3258-7334-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using The Neutrinos. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-7334-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

1409-4549-4893.easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken legendary creature that is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-4549-4893.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the legendary creature that's paired with Deadeye Navigator, adding {U}.
Activate the legendary creature by paying {U} due to Training Grounds, blinking it.
When the legendary creature enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing the legendary creature and Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.

1879-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1879-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1879-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1169-1563-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1169-1563-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6705-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1409-1418-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-3836-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5775-5963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5775-5963-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
5775-5963-7009.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Marvin, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At the end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2457-4365-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2866-3200-3698-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Urza's Bauble enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

4067-6002-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-6002-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-5572-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5572-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4067-6262-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6262-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Marauding Mako triggers, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

997-5263-6243.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2105-3204-4068-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4068-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

647-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
647-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
413-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

2781-5147-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing any amount of damage to any number of targets.

2018-2946-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2946-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing target player to mill cards equal to twice Cult Conscript's power.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1061-4062-5131-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Timesteam Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
You have the city's blessing.
1061-4062-5131-5261.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Entomb without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Entomb, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your graveyard.
Cast Timestream Navigator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2573-3308-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

291-1270-2034.description:
Activate Myr Matrix by paying {5}, creating three 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Myrs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

467-1379-1978-4659-5149.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
Power Artifact attached to Voltaic Construct.
467-1379-1978-4659-5149.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

1647-2713-3371.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1647-2713-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Galvanic Alchemist is paired with Codie.
You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
1647-2713-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

224-1606-4967.notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
224-1606-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Ley Weaver.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers and the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2198-2493-3647-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Deceiver Exarch.
Archaeomancer and Deceiver Exarch enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

776-1329-4474-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4474-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Paradise Mantle to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Paradise Mantle.
Cast Paradise Mantle.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2313-2445-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2313-2445-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.

3249-3652-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
